fusions.name: Shut the Wicker Door
fusions.desc: Closes woven roots on a weakened target: the blow deals 22 damage, leaves it [Caged] for 4 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Hedgerow
fusions.desc: Raises a 5-tile line of root bars ahead of you for 3 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Overgrown Bars
fusions.desc: Roots rise as bars around every creature within 4 tiles and hold it in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Living Ribcage
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, roots close round you as bars: you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
